title: Registry for Observational Studies Assessing the Impact of Diabetes DiGA on Type 2 Diabetes Patients in a Real-world Care Setting - OSAKA
summary: Observational study in real-life care settings to assess the effect of apps (DiGAs) as part of diabetes management on the quality of life and diabetes-specific outcomes of type 2 diabetes patients. To this end, data will be collected from patients for one year after and during the use of the app.

interventions.name: Users of DiGAs (according to BfArM list) in the field of diabetes

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patient with prescription of the Apps
Exclusion criteria:
- Patient not eligible for the Apps prescription
- Patients with impairments – including mental or psychic impairments – or conditions which, in the opinion of the investigator, would seriously compromise the integrity of the study
